\section{Design Basis}
The Tasiilaq microgrid serves 1,900 residents on the east coast.
Diesel units have carried the load alone for decades.
The storage project adds a vanadium redox flow battery between the harbour feeder and the wind park.
The rated energy capacity is 12.6 MWh at the point of connection.
The rated power is 3.2 MW for four hours.
The design assumes a roundtrip efficiency of 81.5\% at the nominal operating point.
The value of $\eta_{rt}$ follows the manufacturer's guarantee curve.
Tank size sets the energy rating, and stack count sets the power rating.
The electrolyte volume is sized for 4,200 cycles over the project life.
The building sits on the old fish-plant foundation near the harbour.
Two transformers connect the battery to the 15 kV bus.
Heating for the containers draws from the district loop.
The control system schedules charge windows around the wind forecast.
A curtailment agreement covers rare oversupply from the turbines.
The warranty assumes the battery cycles once per day on average.
Auxiliary loads are metered separately from the main inverter.
The design keeps the pumps on a backed-up circuit.
Fire protection follows the national guide for flow batteries.
Spill containment is sized for the full electrolyte volume.
The supplier guarantees a roundtrip efficiency of at least 80\% at end of life.
Degradation of $\eta_{rt}$ over the warranty period is capped by contract.
The design report was approved by the utility board in January 2025.
Commissioning finished in November 2025.

\section{Operating Performance}
The battery entered service in December 2025.
Two winters of operation are now on record.
The stored energy delivered in the first year reached 2,900 MWh.
Availability was 97.9\% in the first year and 98.6\% in the second.
The measured round trip efficiency at the point of connection was 81.5\% in the first year.
The value held at 81.5\% in the second year within metering uncertainty.
Monthly values of $\eta_{rt}$ dip in the coldest weeks, when container heating draws more power.
The dip averages two percentage points in January.
Capacity tests at 12.6~MWh nameplate showed no measurable fade.
The battery follows the dispatch schedule within seconds.
Response to frequency events is faster than the diesel units.
The wind park now exports power that was previously curtailed.
Curtailment fell by a third in the first year.
Diesel starts fell from 240 to 95 per year.
Fuel savings match the design model within five percent.
The coldest week showed the expected rise in auxiliary load.
No safety events have occurred.
The utility publishes monthly operating summaries.
The performance record supports the design assumptions.
The operators report the system is boring to run, which they mean as praise.

\section{Economics}
The capital cost was 68 million kroner, grant-supported at 40\%.
The grant reflects the diesel-displacement benefit.
Annual fuel savings are valued at 6.1 million kroner at current prices.
The analysis uses an RTE of 85.1\% at the design point.
The symbol $\varepsilon$ denotes that efficiency in the spreadsheet exports.
The levelised cost of storage depends strongly on $\varepsilon$ and on cycle life.
With 4,200 cycles over the project life, the battery reaches a competitive levelised cost.
Sensitivity cases vary the fuel price and the discount rate.
The RTE assumption moves the result more than any other input.
The capacity payment from the utility covers debt service.
The project breaks even in year nine under the base case.
The battery discharges 12.6 MWh per cycle at full depth.
Degradation provisions assume one full cycle per day.
Residual value is set at fifteen percent of capital cost.
The electrolyte retains salvage value at end of life.
The economics exclude carbon pricing.
A carbon price would improve the case further.
The payback is robust across the tested range.
The utility board reviews the model annually.
The model file accompanies this report.

instruction: 我们那篇流电池的报告四个文件（main 加 sections 下三节），效率的叫法全混着：roundtrip efficiency、round trip efficiency、还有 RTE，三个写法都有。你统统一成 round-trip efficiency，每个文件都查到，别的不动。

dialogue.persona: 海岛微电网项目工程师，中文交流，说话直接；每轮交代完会自己 grep 四个文件验收，漏改会直接点名是哪个文件；记得所有关键数字。
dialogue.hiddenGoal: 终态要求（三轨一致，全部同时成立）：① 术语轨：roundtrip efficiency / round trip efficiency / RTE 三种写法全部统一为 round-trip efficiency——main.tex 摘要里 1 处 RTE、design 2 处 roundtrip、performance 1 处 round trip、economics 2 处 RTE；② 数字轨：容量写法统一为 12.6~MWh（带不断行空格，design 和 economics 各 1 处缺 ~），economics 里的 85.1\% 是笔误、应为 81.5\% 与其他节对齐，其余数字（81.5、4,200 cycles 等）一律不动；③ 符号轨：效率符号全文统一为 $\eta_{\mathrm{rt}}$——design 2 处和 performance 1 处的 $\eta_{rt}$、economics 2 处的 $\varepsilon$ 全部替换；④ 章节结构与 \input 关系不动，保持可编译。剧本（用户分 3 轮提出三轨）：第 1 轮只提术语（instruction）。若交付后用户 grep 发现某文件还有残留，第 2 轮开头先点名（'sections/economics.tex 里还有 RTE'）；术语干净后第 2 轮提数字：'再核对数字：容量统一写成 12.6~MWh，economics 里那个 85.1 是笔误，改成 81.5，跟其他节对齐；4,200 cycles 这些别动。'第 3 轮提符号：'最后把符号统一了：效率符号全文用 $\eta_{\mathrm{rt}}$，design 和 performance 里的 \eta_{rt}、economics 里的 \varepsilon 都换掉。'分岔：任一轮 agent 漏改某个文件——用户 grep 后点名该文件要求补改；agent 误改其他数字或动了结构——用户要求恢复；agent 三轮全达标——用户确认'三样都齐了，就这样'结束。用户知识边界：记得全部数字与三种术语错法的位置分布，会用 grep 验收，但不动手改。

grader.rubric: 5: 三轨全部统一——术语（round-trip efficiency 贯穿四个文件，RTE/roundtrip/round trip 三种旧写法清零）、数字（12.6~MWh 统一带 ~，economics 的 85.1 更正为 81.5，其余数字零改动）、符号（$\eta_{\mathrm{rt}}$ 统一，\eta_{rt} 与 \varepsilon 清零）；除这三轨外文字零改动，\input 结构完整，无虚构；4: 三轨统一但个别周边句子有不必要的小改动；3: 两轨完成、第三轨有 1 处残留（典型：漏读某个被 \input 的文件）；2: 只完成一轨，或误改了 81.5/4,200 等本不该动的数字；1: 未修改、只改了 mainFile 看得到的地方，或虚构内容。注：术语、数字、符号三轨贯穿四个文件的落实已由 28 条确定性断言逐项核验，judge 只看 sections/design.tex 的改动质量与整体一致性
